name: HelloFresh

fastest.text: Log in on hellofresh.com, open hellofresh.com/cancellation and follow the prompts, by 11:59 PM PT five days before your next delivery.

steps: Log in to your HelloFresh account on hellofresh.com.
Open the cancellation page, hellofresh.com/cancellation (HelloFresh's help center links to it).
Follow the prompts. A summary screen shows how much HelloFresh Cash you'll lose.
Finish by 11:59 PM PT, five days before your next scheduled delivery.
note: Only need a break? Skip a week instead: My Menu → pick the delivery day → Edit Delivery → Skip This Week.

faq.a: 11:59 PM PT, five days before your next scheduled delivery. HelloFresh can't cancel a box after that cut-off, and you pay for orders already processed.
Most credits, including referral bonuses, promotional offers and credits from customer care, are removed when you cancel. The cancellation summary shows how much HelloFresh Cash you'd lose.
Yes. Log in and use the Reactivate button; you don't need to go through checkout again.
